To find the total drug dose in milligrams, we multiply the person's weight by the dosage per kilogram:
$$\text{Total dose in mg} = 62 \text{ kg} \times 15 \text{ mg/kg}$$
$$62 \times 15 = 930 \text{ mg}$$

Next, we need to convert the dose from milligrams to grams. Since $1 \text{ gram} = 1000 \text{ milligrams}$, we divide the total milligrams by 1000:
$$\text{Total dose in g} = \frac{930}{1000} = 0.93 \text{ g}$$

Looking at the options provided:
(A) 930
(B) 93
(C) 9.3
(D) 0.93

Final answer: D
